sources_json.mve_profile_fix: Removed -mfpu=fpv5-d16 from g2-apollo-main-mve-1. On Apple clang that flag set __ARM_FEATURE_MVE=1 (integer only) and rejected vmulq_f32 / vmul.f32 q. Without it, -mcpu=cortex-m55 -mfloat-abi=hard sets __ARM_FEATURE_MVE=3 and ACLE compiles.
sources_json.notes_updated: source.c no longer points at cores.S; leaves note mentions process + MVE ACLE.

leaves_freestanding_fix: g2c_fuel_gauge_leaves.c dropped #include <string.h> (not present on the Apple-clang arm-none-eabi freestanding profile) and declares memcpy/memset plus stddef.h.

linker_report.docstring_and_qualification: Replaced the canned 'source-only uncalibrated' / 'not the stock Nordic algorithm' wording. Qualification now says the fuel gauge is typographic C, bit-exact versus typographic stock on Renode 1.17 M55 (hardware calibration unproven).

bb14_count_4_to_8.method: Direct C vs typographic stock_fg_43bb14 on Renode 1.17 M55. Typographic body copied with a widened 0x50-byte frame (index at sp+4, abs/temp at sp+0x10, raw at sp+0x30) so count 4..8 do not overlap. Control flow unchanged.
bb14_count_4_to_8.note: Stock only considers the first two abs values unless count==3 (which also considers index 2). The mid6 'max-abs at last index' property was not typographic behavior and was dropped from mid6_harness.c. Production fg_43bb14 was not changed.
